Package soot.toolkits.exceptions

Class PreciseThrowAnalysis

  • java.lang.Object
    • soot.toolkits.exceptions.AbstractThrowAnalysis
      • soot.toolkits.exceptions.UnitThrowAnalysis
        • soot.toolkits.exceptions.PreciseThrowAnalysis
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ThrowAnalysis
    public class PreciseThrowAnalysis
extends UnitThrowAnalysis
    A ThrowAnalysis which returns the set of runtime exceptions and errors that might be thrown by the instructions represented by a unit. Note that in contrast to a UnitThrowAnalysis, this analysis can be more precise in cases where it can statically determine that certain exceptions can never be thrown in practice. Note that this analysis might be relatively slow due to the overhead of checking plausible exceptions.
    Author:
    Marc Miltenberger
